item.title: Elon Musk says Tesla will return some Cybertruck deposits
item.description: Musk said Monday that the Cybertruck order rate "far exceeds" Tesla's production pace.

item.title: Trump says he sees no reason to escalate war with Iran
item.description: President Trump told 60 Minutes the war with Iran was a "good decision" in the long term, despite its short-term impact.

item.title: Trump told "60 Minutes" his immigration policy was too tough. Then he promoted Stephen Miller.
item.description: In a "60 Minutes" interview, President Trump acknowledged his immigration policy may have been "too tough" and could have impacted the midterm results. CBS News' Aaron Navarro reports, and Camilo Montoya-Galvez has more on Stephen Miller's promotion to White House chief of staff.

item.title: Teens face charges over swing ride mayhem at Georgia fair
item.description: Two teens in Georgia are facing charges after causing mayhem on a swing ride at a local fair. Skyler Henry reports.

item.title: Jury deliberations resume in Sandra Birchmore trial
item.description: The jury is deliberating in the trial of Matthew Farwell, a former Massachusetts police officer who is accused of strangling 23-year-old Sandra Birchmore and staging it to look like a suicide. Tom Hanson reports.

item.title: Congress returns for lame-duck sprint after GOP midterm losses
item.description: Lawmakers are returning to Capitol Hill for the first time since the midterm elections, which delivered a slew of Democratic victories that will dramatically reshape the balance of power in Washington in the new year.

item.title: Russell Brand set to be sentenced for rape, sexual assault convictions
item.description: Russell Brand is set to be sentenced in Britain for rape and sexual assault convictions. Holly Williams reports.

item.title: Man who carried out mass shooting in Poland has died, police say
item.description: The Polish man suspected of killing six people in a shooting attack in Krakow, described as an "act of terror" by senior officials, has died of his injuries.

item.title: Trump's deportation policy remains in focus as Stephen Miller becomes chief of staff
item.description: President Trump told 60 Minutes correspondent Ross Douthat that his administration's immigration policies "may have been too tough." But Democrats aren't expecting a slowdown in deportations after Mr. Trump's promotion of Stephen Miller to chief of staff. Ed O'Keefe reports.

item.title: Eye Opener: Trump reckons with midterm results
item.description: President Trump is reckoning with Republican midterm losses. Meanwhile, the Nvidia CEO admitted to an affair as he's investigated for ties to a suspected Chinese spy. All that and all that matters in today's Eye Opener.

item.title: Key moments from ex-cop's trial in the death of Sandra Birchmore
item.description: A jury in Massachusetts is deliberating the fate of former police officer Matthew Farwell, who is charged in the 2021 death of 23-year-old Sandra Birchmore.

item.title: Trump says U.S. took a "giant step back in history" with midterm results
item.description: President Trump on Sunday said the U.S. "took a giant step back in history" as his White House continued to roil from his post-midterm shakeup

item.title: Mississippi Senate race still a toss-up; Democrat holds slim lead
item.description: The Senate race in deep-red Mississippi remains unresolved, as Democrat Scott Colom has mounted a surprisingly competitive challenge to incumbent Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith.

item.title: Dozens of migrants dead on boats in Europe, scores rescued
item.description: Dozens of migrants trying to reach the Greek island of Crete or Spain died on boats and scores were rescued as the steady stream of such migrants showed no signs of diminishing, authorities said.

item.description: The state prosecutor's office said that Aranza, a 7-year-old who was born in the United States, was hit in the head by police gunfire.

item.title: Okinawa governor calls for review of U.S.-Japan troops pact
item.description: Okinawa's governor says he is going to request a review of a pact seen as giving the U.S. military preferential treatment in Japan, following a murder allegedly committed by an American Marine​.

item.description: The board of Nvidia said it had no reason to believe that the company's secrets or national security were compromised.

item.title: Supermarkets, water control systems, more hacked around U.S., world
item.description: Authorities around the world are trying to find the source of a series of bomb threats and cyberattacks. Ramy Inocencio reports from Paris.

item.title: Trump prepares for a fight with Congress, assembling more combative White House
item.description: Lawmakers are returning to Washington, D.C., to a stunning new political reality, and President Trump is vowing to fight back against the new Congress after the midterm blowout. He spoke with 60 Minutes correspondent Ross Douthat and Olivia Gazis reports on the lawmakers' return.

item.title: Nvidia probing CEO after he admitted to affair with alleged Chinese spy
item.description: AI giant Nvidia says it has opened an investigation into its CEO and co-founder, Jensen Huang, after he admitted to having a relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. Akiko Fujita reports.

item.title: Trump says he was kidding when he offered UFC CEO press secretary role
item.description: The role of the White House press secretary has been largely vacant since Karoline Leavitt stepped aside ​in August.

item.description: In a wide-ranging conversation, President Trump discusses Republican losses in the midterms, his potential successors, the Iran war, immigration, allegations of corruption, and artificial intelligence.

item.description: In an interview with 60 Minutes, President Trump said his administration's deportation policy might have been "too tough" in pursuing immigrants with "good jobs."
